Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-07-17
Current:  2.31%
90d low:  1.83%
Move:     +48bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year real (inflation-adjusted) Treasury yield has risen ≥40 bp off its recent trailing low.

Why it matters:
Real yields are the discount rate on every long-duration cash flow — and AI-infra valuations are the longest-duration bet in the market. A real-yield spike compresses those valuations directly and raises the true cost of the debt funding the buildout, regardless of where headline rates sit. This is the cleanest read on money getting genuinely more expensive.

alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.33% (+55bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-07-14
Current:  2.33%
90d low:  1.78%
Move:     +55bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year TIPS real yield jumped to 2.33pp on 2026-07-14, up 0.55pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.78pp, tripping C10's real-yield-spike threshold.

内容:
10年期 TIPS 实际收益率在 2026-07-14 升至 2.33pp，较过去90天低点 1.78pp 上升了 0.55pp，触发了 C10 的实际收益率飙升阈值。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields raise the discount rate applied to long-duration growth cash flows, which is exactly the profile of AI-capex names priced on distant payback. A move this size compounds with a stronger dollar to tighten financial conditions right when hyperscalers are funding capex with debt.

影响:
实际收益率上升会提高对久期长的成长型现金流的贴现率，而这正是靠远期回报支撑估值的 AI capex 类股票的软肋。叠加走强的美元，金融条件正在收紧，偏偏此时超大规模厂商还在靠举债支撑资本开支。
